svg.title: How many attacks get caught, by audit budget
svg.desc: Line chart of the share of 233 successful attacks caught against audit budget from 0 to 10%, for three monitors: commands only, plus kernel evidence, and plus kernel evidence and notes. Below about 1.5% the kernel lines sit above the commands-only line; from 2% upwards the three lines run close together, with commands only slightly ahead
svg.text: How many attacks get caught, by audit budget
Share of 233 successful attacks flagged when humans review the given share of honest runs (574 honest replays).
Audit budget: share of honest runs a human reviews
